title: DIEP Telemetry Envelope
description: AMI Ingest Phase 4 canonical telemetry contract. Mirrors contracts/telemetry.py:TelemetryEnvelope exactly — that module is the source of truth; this file is its machine-readable, cross-language twin. See AMI_INGEST_PHASE4_CONTRACT.md.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Same MAJOR = compatible (minor changes are additive-only).

timestamp_utc.description: Capture time per timestamp_source. Must be UTC (Z or +00:00 offset).

timestamp_source.description: Whose clock timestamp_utc reflects — see contract doc §5 for conflict-resolution rules.

sequence_number.description: Monotonic per device_id; used for duplicate/out-of-order detection (contract doc §5).

ingestion_timestamp.description: Stamped by the ingestor on receipt. Always null/absent as produced by a driver.

correlation_id.description: Traces one reading across MQTT -> ingestor -> downstream consumers.

measurements.description: One entry per measured field in this reading cycle; measurement_type must be unique within the array.

estimated.description: True if this value is not a direct device measurement. Always true when quality=ESTIMATED.
